title: MedInVedic Platform Overview, Founder & Services
content: MedInVedic is an integrated healthcare platform founded by Mahesh Badiger. Tagline: 'Where Modern Medicine Meets Ancient Ayurveda'. Website: https://medinvedic.web.app. Founder: Mahesh Badiger. MedInVedic bridges modern CDSCO/WHO evidence-based allopathic pharmacology with classical AYUSH Ayurvedic medicine. Core features include AI Clinical Assistant, certified doctor consultations, authenticated prescription verification, and nationwide pharmacy and herbal wellness delivery.
